rows.text: In the Lok Sabha on 29 July 1997 Shri Ram Naik said, in the official translation, that 'many things have come up regarding the Leader of the House, Shri Ram Vilas Paswan and party president, Shri Sharad Yadav'.
In the same debate Shri Anandrao Vithoba Adsul (Buldhana) said, in the official translation, that 'Democratically elected president Shri Sharad Yadav can not go there freely'.

locator.section: speech of Shri Anandrao Vithoba Adsul (Buldhana), begun on PDF page 23

rows.text: In the same debate Shri Virendra Kumar Singh said, in the official translation, that 'Rashtriya Janata Dal is functioning under the leadership of Laloo Yadav ji. Laloo Yadav ji is the party president and he would remain so.'
